tasks.task: Create custom exception classes (AC: #1, #2) Create DuplicateSessionError exception Create DuplicateFindingError exception Add to rustybt/validation/exceptions.py (or models.py)

Implement session duplicate detection (AC: #1) Modify SessionManager.create() to check for existing IN_PROGRESS sessions Use find_sessions(strategy=name, status="IN_PROGRESS") Raise DuplicateSessionError if found Include existing session ID and suggested commands in message

Implement finding duplicate detection (AC: #2) Modify add_finding() to check for duplicates Compare layer, event, timestamp for uniqueness Raise DuplicateFindingError if duplicate found Include existing finding ID in error message
Update CLI with clear error handling (AC: #3) Catch DuplicateSessionError in session create Format user-friendly error message Show suggested commands to resolve

Implement --force flag (AC: #4) Add --force option to session create command When --force and duplicate exists: mark old as SUPERSEDED Add SUPERSEDED status to Session model Create new session and warn about superseded
Write unit tests (AC: #5) Test duplicate session detection Test duplicate finding detection Test --force flag creates new session Test SUPERSEDED status preserved

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Session duplicate detection implemented - Check for existing IN_PROGRESS session with same strategy before create. Raise DuplicateSessionError with clear message. Suggest using session resume or session delete
Finding duplicate detection implemented - Check for existing finding with same layer/event/timestamp. Raise DuplicateFindingError if duplicate found. Include existing finding ID in error message
CLI provides clear error messages - On duplicate session show existing session ID and suggested commands. On duplicate finding show existing finding ID
--force flag allows override - rustybt-validate session create --strategy X --data Y --force marks existing session as SUPERSEDED, creates new session, shows warning message about superseded session

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: FR40: System can prevent duplicate investigations across sessions. Strategy + IN_PROGRESS status combination defines session uniqueness.

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: findings.yaml stores findings with id, layer, description, classification. Finding uniqueness based on layer + event + timestamp.

doc.title: Epic 3: Session Management System
doc.snippet: DuplicateSessionError includes existing session ID and suggested commands. --force flag marks existing as SUPERSEDED. Superseded sessions preserved for audit trail.

doc.title: Story 3.3 - Session Query Commands
doc.snippet: find_sessions() with filters enables duplicate detection. Can filter by strategy and status to find conflicts.
